Implement A06 human correction revisions and reversible CONTENT adoption in the OStag integration using this isolated native osstack worktree. Actual parent Fable 5.1 challenges your final source. This slice is explicit local domain/service API, A11 is responsible for authenticated transport and server lifecycle. Do not claim live buttons or live platform tested.

Choose compact clear implementation and meaningful tests. Requirements:
1. Separate explicitly initialized owned SQLite revision ledger (strict application_id/version/DDL, no arbitrary existing/foreign/future schema mutation, journal DELETE/synchronous FULL, short bounded busy timeout). Do NOT change original BriefStore schema2/3/4, original revision/outbox, TEXT wire or card send ledger. Root is an exact trusted stored PrivatePreview, not user payload. Require explicit current bounded local loader(scope,job) returning original root preview, and authorize callback checking every current source/grant/owner/destination/binding generation/outbox cancellation. Document callbacks non-reentrant/no IO under SQLite lock/latency externally bounded. Use distinct typed fixed errors with no secret repr or exception causes/context. Namespace, principal, job, source/window/purpose/audience/full root content+links/destination/binding frozen and compared each operation including same-ID-content mutation. Only source of root is trusted loader; no user-auth flags. Data passed to local API can identify expected revision, never replace root. Use fail-closed strict scalar/types/JSON bounds/no bool-as-int. Root checks and authorization AFTER ALL database reads/writes/waits at logical precommit/release. Clock monotonic highwater across restarts for mutation timestamps; time type checks. Reads similarly reauthorize before returning private content. No network/model calls, no settings bypass to business approvals.
2. A correction is clearly attributed HUMAN annotation to the draft (whole-draft or strictly validated section/item reference), never a new asserted source fact and never edits SourceSet, original claim, URL, coverage, provenance or raw excerpt. Keep immutable root snapshot digest and revision chain, unique child per expected HEAD via CAS; record parent_revision_id, authenticated editor, timestamp, exact correction text and request id. IDs server random sufficiently strong and validated. Limit text/chain/total ledger rows with practical hard bounds. Store parent and actor fields immutable; preserve history. Root revision is original ID, new revision IDs distinct; corrected view explicitly separates original draft from ordered human corrections (all ancestors visible), immutable detached result. No silent truncation. Existing original preview/renderer remains unchanged. Expose render function in revisions.py or service method to show original source-backed pages and separate correction pages/metadata, every page notice corrections are unverified human input and adoption is not business approval. Defang all untrusted text using existing defang, only original trusted source links may be active. Keep <=16KiB/page, preserve gaps and every correction, clear revision and parent/editor references; no arbitrary callback/button/action URLs from corrections. Bound rendering work and test oversized/adversarial Unicode input.
3. Exact expected_revision_id required for correction, adopt and withdraw: never default latest on mutation. Operation idempotency scoped to requester/job/request id, exact semantic payload comparison before replay (changed intent conflict); whole mutation+idempotency+head/adoption event atomic. Replayed correction does not add revision. Replayed historical adopt MUST NOT re-adopt after withdraw or after new revision (return clearly historical receipt, current state separately or conflict; never misreport currently adopted). Adoption model explicitly content-only, business_approved always false or no capability of that kind. New correction invalidates current adoption (preserve history), stale prior card revision argument cannot adopt newer/current revision. Record adoption/retraction as immutable events with actor and exact revision. Retraction possible for the authenticated owner; bounded explicit behavior if current access revoked (no private content release; choose documented fail-closed rather than silently changing business authority). Handle two concurrent connections expected HEAD conflicts, same event dedup, distinct operations exactly serialize. Same principal different namespace and other principals cannot read/mutate. Ownership from RequesterContext not editor string. No HTTP auth invented: API explicitly expects trusted authenticated context; A11 must bind signed card revision server-side rather than accept browser latest. Prove with original A05 preview revision that stale confirmation is denied after correction. Original card objects unchanged; no hidden send or automatic update.
4. Use separated ledger with all authority from original root current loader; initialized root registration transaction needs idempotency/restart safe. Check consistency under concurrent root registration; durable record reads must validate metadata integrity/schema. SQLite/loader/authorizer failures fixed errors, no excerpts, tokens or paths in public errors; no catches that return success on failure. Corruption/foreign/version rejection must not alter files/tables. Clearly document trusted local disk and transaction commit ambiguity/idempotent recovery constraints. Do not claim filesystem tamper protection or cross-system atomicity. Rollback all mutation if final current policy/clock fails; no private data from denied/cross-scope status/history/errors. Bounds remain durable across instances/restart; avoid huge schema boilerplate.

Test real A04 BriefStore complete/outbox -> PrivatePreview -> corrections rendered -> adoption->retraction->replay/restart; original generation tables/outbox payload/source bytes remain unchanged. Include direct SQLite race/two connections/restart, rollback/fault injection/final source revocation AFTER lock or render, stale original card revision, cross-scope/destination/generation/content drift, exact event dedup vs changed payload, parent/editor/history/chain caps, malformed/foreign/future DB rejection without mutation, correction script/URL/@mentions defanging/no clickable injection, valid trusted links preserved and all source coverage and correction text available with page limits, timestamps rollback and invalid values, private repr/error hygiene. Keep old tests untouched. Run new focused tests and Ruff; parent runs full suite (baseline2395) and 13 existing independent regression gates.
